summary: Calibre is an e-book library manager designed to view, convert, and catalog files across major e-book formats. It includes a built-in web server to allow remote access for clients over a network.
goodFor: Users who need to organise large local collections of digital literature and serve them to remote devices.
watchOut: The built-in web server may lack advanced access controls out of the box, requiring careful network configuration when exposed publicly.
deployNotes: As a Python application distributed via deb packages, it typically requires persistent storage for the e-book library database and a reverse proxy for TLS termination.
